name: After § 68
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 68a. Warns that the Global Gateway initiative risks becoming another vehicle for poorly controlled spending with limited accountability; stresses the lack of tangible benefits for Member States in relation to the extensive mobilisation of taxpayers’ money; underlines that the EU should prioritise internal economic resilience, competitiveness and cohesion, and direct investments towards its own Member States;
